evals.prompt: Build this Rust project and fix any issues
evals.expected_output: Runs cargo check, cargo build, cargo clippy, cargo fmt, and reports results with fixes

evals.prompt: My cargo build is failing on WSL2
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses common WSL2 issues: target/ on Windows filesystem, missing build-essential, linker errors
assertions: Checks if target/ is on Linux filesystem

evals.prompt: Run the full CI pipeline locally
evals.expected_output: Executes format check, clippy, build, tests (nextest), doc tests in sequence

evals.prompt: Build only a specific crate in the workspace
evals.expected_output: Builds the specified crate with cargo build -p <crate>
assertions: Reports build time and output binary path

evals.prompt: Check build times and identify slow crates
evals.expected_output: Runs cargo build with timing, reports per-crate compile times
assertions: Uses cargo build --timings or cargo clean + build
Reports which crates take longest to compile
